purpose: Teach: ルノー/葛飾/ジャッキー/ポーカー/ドラクエ/マスターズ/ワンセグ/スペースシャトル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがルノーの車を運転された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to drive a Renault.
lines.style: Soft, searching tone as if reaching back through decades. Gentle opening attack. Slow, thoughtful pace. Voice trails at the end—half question, half remembrance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、葛飾区にゆかりの方だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and didn't your grandfather have family ties to Katsushika, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing undertone. Light, conversational pace. Tender correction wrapped in affection—redirecting gently without sting. Eyes crinkling at the edge of the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがジャッキーチェンの映画を映画館でご覧になった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he watched a Jackie Chan film at the cinema.
lines.style: Same searching quality as before. Opening soft and exploratory. Unhurried. A small pause before 'cinema'—like he can almost see it happening. Fades slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ポーカーをご友人と楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to enjoy playing poker with his friends, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle correction again, but with more warmth this time. Matter-of-fact affection. Steady pace. The 'dear' lands softly, almost musical—she's reminding him of who he is.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお孫様のドラクエ攻略を見守られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he watched over his grandson's Dragon Quest adventures.
lines.style: More present now—less distant. Still wistful but with a slight lift of quiet pride. Voice steadies on the memory. Gentle pace. Small warmth breaking through.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年、マスターズ中継をご覧になるのが楽しみだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: In his later years, he looked forward to watching the Masters tournament, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Voice carries quiet respect for his later life. Steady, almost ceremonial pace. 'Dear' is tender anchor. She's honoring what mattered to him without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがワンセグの登場に驚かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was amazed by the arrival of One-seg television.
lines.style: Slight lift in energy—a small wonder in the voice. Opening is gentle but more engaged. Pace quickens minutely on 'amazed.' Trails off thoughtfully, like he's smiling at the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、スペースシャトル打ち上げを録画して観てらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to record the Space Shuttle launches and watch them, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmest yet. Voice is tender and intimate, almost like a lullaby. Slow, loving pace. 'Dear' closes the thought like a soft hand. She's speaking to him across time and memory.
